text:
ops-bot: alert -> ECC/soft Xid errors detected in ap-southeast-1 private pool
Sam (Infra): noticed repeated ECC corrected counts on nodes gpu-as1-04 and gpu-as1-07, plus intermittent Xid 13 on streaming jobs. flagging for triage.
Aisha (CS): heads up — we have 3 active Dedicated customers in that region. they’ll want a comms plan if we need a drain/replace.
Noah (Oncall): oncall taking initial triage. can you paste the raw nvidia-smi logs?
Sam (Infra): pasted logs in thread:
```
--- gpu-as1-04 ---
2026-03-12T02:11:03Z ECC single-bit corrected: +324
2026-03-12T02:53:41Z Xid 13 on process id 8347 (inference-worker)
--- gpu-as1-07 ---
2026-03-12T03:04:12Z ECC single-bit corrected: +289
2026-03-12T03:40:05Z repeated Xid 13 spikes during long seq workloads
```
Sam (Infra): short summary: corrected ECC rising, Xid 13 correlates with long-sequence requests at >1M tokens/day. no kernel oops. card still responsive but flakiness increasing.
Jules (Eng): likely aging memory channel issue — standard pattern we've seen before. recommend draining then scheduled replacement, not emergency replacement unless Xid escalates to Xid 31 / GPU hang.
Aisha (CS): ok, customers need: a plain-language note, expected impact, timing, mitigation steps, and contact/SLR. i can draft.
Noah (Oncall): also include temporary routing to nearby region (ap-southeast-2) option and cost implications if they opt-in.
Aisha (CS): draft for customers (please comment):
```
Hi — We're reaching out to let you know we've detected increasing GPU memory-correction events on a small number of nodes in our ap-southeast-1 private/dedicated fleet that may affect inference latencies for some workloads.
What we're doing: We will proactively drain affected GPUs and replace the hardware during a maintenance window to avoid unplanned disruptions. During the maintenance we will route workloads to healthy capacity in the same region when available, otherwise to ap-southeast-2.
Expected impact: Most requests will not be affected. Customers with very long-sequence or sustained high-throughput workloads may see elevated latency or transient retries while routing occurs. No model or data will be lost.
Planned window: UTC 2026-03-13 02:00–04:00 (local evening) — tentative, we will update 2 hours prior.
If you prefer: We can provision temporary burst capacity in ap-southeast-2 during the window (additional usage charges may apply).
Contact: reply to this thread or open a support ticket and we'll escalate to oncall.
```
Sam (Infra): tweak: add list of affected node IDs and mention that we will run pre-replacement stress test for 1 hour to validate.
Aisha (CS): updated snippet with small changes pasted.
Jules (Eng): also add a line: "If you run pinned resources to specific devices, please let us know so we can coordinate." otherwise automatic routing is transparent.
Aisha (CS): final customer note ready — will send once ops confirms replacement ETA. assigning draft -> @noah-oncall to confirm maintenance window. :calendar: :paperclip:
Noah (Oncall): confirmed window OK for me; ops runbook step-by-step below, keeping downtime minimal:
1) mark nodes `drain=true` in fleet manager
2) shift active sessions with grace period 90s
3) run 1hr stress validation on spare node
4) swap GPU card and run burn-in tests (30m)
5) promote node back to pool
Sam (Infra): adding automation: if Xid count >500 in 24h we auto-schedule replacement and notify customers.
Aisha (CS): good — i'll send message in 30m with subject line: "Planned maintenance: GPU replacement in ap-southeast-1 (tentative)" and link to support articles.
Jules (Eng): one more ops note: if we hit Xid 31 or kernel oops we escalate to emergency replacement and customer comms will reflect possible short service interruption.
Aisha (CS): acknowledged. i'll keep the tone calm, emphasize no data loss and routing. will request customer preference for cross-region routing.
Sam (Infra): follow-up: reassigning GPUs to spare pool now to lower live load. monitoring dashboards updated.
Noah (Oncall): will monitor alerts; ping me if CPU/GPU scheduling latency spikes.
Aisha (CS): sending drafts now. will paste final sent message after dispatch. :email:
ops-bot: maintenance scheduled -> ticket #INC-20260313-142
Aisha (CS): SENT to affected accounts at 2026-03-12T17:02:11Z — pasted copy attached above.
Sam (Infra): postmortem checklist stub created. we'll capture ECC counts, Xid rates, and replacement serials.
Jules (Eng): thanks team. keep thread updated if anything changes. :thumbsup:
